events.factual_description: Birdland Theater presents Donny McCaslin, Ben Allison and Steve Smith in WAY OUT WEST — A Birthday Tribute to Sonny Rollins from Friday, September 11 through Sunday, September 13, 2026. Birdland lists two sets each night at 7:00 PM and 9:30 PM, with doors at 5:30 PM and 9:00 PM respectively, and lists tickets from $35.46 to $45.76. The announced lineup is Donny McCaslin on tenor saxophone, Ben Allison on bass and Steve Smith on drums. Steve Smith's official schedule identifies the program as Way Out West — The Music of Sonny Rollins and describes the trio as celebrating Rollins's music and enduring influence. Sonny Rollins's official site documents the 1957 Way Out West session with Rollins on tenor saxophone, Ray Brown on bass and Shelly Manne on drums.

en.why_it_matters: The title and instrumentation make this more specific than a generic standards tribute. McCaslin, Allison and Smith work in the same exposed tenor-bass-drums architecture documented on Rollins's 1957 Way Out West, putting rhythmic conversation and improvisational space at the center. With three players who can carry that openness without a chordal instrument, the lineage is audible in the setup before a note of repertoire is chosen.
en.trip_verdict: If a New York trip intersects September 11-13, actively make room for one set at Birdland. Six performances across three nights give enough flexibility to fit it around the rest of the trip rather than reorganize the regional itinerary around a single scarce slot.

es.why_it_matters: El título y la instrumentación vuelven este homenaje mucho más específico que otra noche de standards. McCaslin, Allison y Smith retoman la misma arquitectura expuesta de saxo tenor, bajo y batería documentada en Way Out West de Rollins en 1957, dejando el diálogo rítmico y el espacio de improvisación en primer plano. Con tres músicos capaces de sostener esa apertura sin instrumento armónico, el linaje se escucha desde la propia formación antes de saber qué temas tocarán.
es.trip_verdict: Si un viaje a Nueva York coincide con el 11-13 de septiembre, sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los sets en Birdland. Seis funciones en tres noches dan suficiente flexibilidad para acomodarlo dentro del viaje sin reorganizar todo el itinerario regional alrededor de un solo horario escaso.
